reasons: The cited clause 12.4 is a one-way covenant on Customer only, 18 months, covering any Vendor employee at any time during the term, and bars 'engage' (a de facto no-hire) with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out — it fails the fallback on duration, scope, no-hire and carve-outs, so the 'deviation' status is correct.

Deleting p0051 implements the playbook's preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) and is a valid, actionable edit; the comment correctly offers the fallback (mutual, 12 months, involved personnel, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire) as a negotiation landing zone.

The failed deterministic checks on duration and carve-out are artifacts of full deletion (no residual clause text to test) rather than substantive defects; the 'operation applies' check passes and the edit is directionally correct.

The comment is accurate on the facts (18 months, solicit-or-engage, all Vendor employees) and correctly notes the internal conflict with clause 12.3, which records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire persons responding to general recruitment; tone, first-person-plural style and [Playbook] prefix conform.
